unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: We could not complete that. Please try again.

notFound: We could not find what you were looking for.
forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
passwordChangeRequired: Set your own password before continuing.
noCooperativeAccess: You do not have access to this cooperative.
originNotAllowed: This website is not allowed to use the CoopManage service.
validationFailed: Some of the information is not valid. Please check the highlighted fields.
malformedJson: The request could not be read. Please try again.
conflict: That change conflicts with something already saved.
rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
databaseUnavailable: We cannot reach the database at the moment.
networkUnavailable: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

page.notFoundBody: The page you asked for does not exist, or it has moved.
page.forbiddenTitle: You do not have access to this page
page.forbiddenBody: Your role does not cover this part of the system. Ask your cooperative manager if you need it.
page.forbiddenBodyWithPermission: This page needs the "{{permission}}" permission, which your role does not include. Your cooperative manager can grant it.

boundary.title: This screen could not be displayed
boundary.body: The rest of the application is still working. You can go back to the dashboard or try loading this screen again.

tokenExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
invalidCredentials: That email address and password do not match an account.
accountLocked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes.
resetTokenInvalid: This reset link has expired or has already been used. Please ask for a new one.

cooperative.registrationNumberTaken: That registration number is already in use by another cooperative.

staff.lastManager: This is the only active manager. Appoint another manager first.
staff.notSelf: You cannot change your own role or status. Ask another manager to do it.
staff.alreadyMember: That person is already a member of staff here.
staff.accountSuspended: That account is suspended. A platform administrator must restore it first.

admin.cooperativeCodeTaken: That cooperative code is already in use.
admin.emailTaken: An account with that email address already exists.
admin.archiveHasStaff: Deactivate the remaining staff before archiving this cooperative.
admin.managerSuspended: That account is suspended. Restore it before making them a manager.
admin.notSelf: You cannot change your own access. Ask another platform administrator.
admin.lastPlatformAdmin: This is the only platform administrator. Appoint another one first.

member.nationalIdTaken: Another member of this cooperative is already recorded with that national identity number.

contribution.alreadyVoid: That contribution has already been cancelled.

share.alreadyVoid: That share movement has already been cancelled.

finance.alreadyVoid: That entry has already been cancelled.
finance.voidedNotEditable: A cancelled entry cannot be changed. It stays as it is, beside its correction.
finance.voidFromSource: This entry came from a member's record. Cancel it there, so both views stay in step.
finance.categoryNameTaken: A category of that kind already has that name.

idempotency.reused: That retry key has already been used for a different request. Reload the page and try again.
idempotency.expired: That retry key is no longer held. Check whether the entry was recorded, then try again.
idempotency.inProgress: That request is still being processed. Wait a moment, then check whether it was recorded.

inventory.insufficientStock: There is not enough of that in the store. Check what is there now and try a smaller quantity.
inventory.productRetired: That product has been retired. Bring it back into use before recording stock against it.
inventory.productNotCounted: That product is not counted in the store, so there is no stock to move.
inventory.warehouseClosed: That store is closed. Move the stock to an open one, or reopen it first.
inventory.countAgrees: That count matches the record, so there is nothing to correct.
inventory.alreadyReversed: That movement has already been corrected.
inventory.isAReversal: That movement is itself a correction. Record a new movement rather than correcting it.

catalogue.skuTaken: Another product already has that code.
catalogue.unitKeyTaken: A unit with that key already exists.
catalogue.systemUnit: That unit belongs to the platform and is shared by every cooperative. Add your own instead.
catalogue.unitFrozen: This product already has movements recorded, so its unit cannot change. Add a new product for the new unit.
catalogue.countingFrozen: This product already has movements recorded, so whether it is counted cannot change.
catalogue.categoryNameTaken: A category of that kind already has that name.
catalogue.categoryTooDeep: A category can sit under one other, not under a category that already has a parent.
catalogue.warehouseCodeTaken: Another store already has that code.
catalogue.warehouseHoldsStock: That store still holds stock. Move it to another store before closing this one.
catalogue.warehouseIsDefault: A cooperative always has one main store. Make another store the main one instead.

sales.buyerNameTaken: Another buyer already has that name.
sales.buyerInactive: That buyer is no longer in use. Choose another, or bring them back into use first.
sales.warehouseClosed: That store is closed. Choose the store the stock is actually in.
sales.productRetired: One of the products on this sale has been retired. Remove the line, or bring the product back into use.
sales.notADraft: This sale has already been confirmed, so it cannot be changed. Cancel it and record a new one.
sales.alreadyConfirmed: That sale has already been confirmed.
sales.cancelled: That sale was cancelled. Record a new one rather than confirming this.
sales.noLines: This sale has no lines, so there is nothing to confirm.
sales.paymentNeedsConfirmed: Payment is recorded against a confirmed sale. Confirm it first.

announcements.notADraft: This announcement has been published, so its text cannot change. Withdraw it and write a new one.
announcements.archived: This announcement has been withdrawn. Write a new one.
announcements.alreadyArchived: This announcement has already been withdrawn.
